scripts.lint:packages: publint run --pack pnpm packages/svg-icons && publint run --pack pnpm packages/react-icons
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm lint:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: test "$(git symbolic-ref --quiet HEAD)" != refs/heads/main || { echo "Direct commits to main are not allowed. Create a feature branch." >&2; exit 1; }
simple-git-hooks.pre-merge-commit: test "$(git symbolic-ref --quiet HEAD)" != refs/heads/main || { echo "Local merge commits on main are not allowed. Open a pull request." >&2; exit 1; }
simple-git-hooks.pre-push: while read -r local_ref local_sha remote_ref remote_sha; do if [ "$remote_ref" = refs/heads/main ]; then echo "Direct pushes to main are not allowed. Open a pull request." >&2; exit 1; fi; done
